d: We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Senior Business Development Officer to help drive BCDR's growth and expand the use of its arbitration and ADR services across the MENA region. Working closely with the Business Development Director, you'll identify and assess new opportunities, manage partnerships with government entities, ADR institutions, chambers of commerce, law firms and academic institutions, and represent BCDR at conferences, forums and roadshows. You'll also draft partnership proposals and MoUs, track market and competitor trends, manage the business development pipeline, and supervise the Business Development Officer. The ideal candidate is a confident relationship builder with strong analytical, presentation and negotiation skills, a good understanding of the ADR landscape, and fluency in Arabic and English. If you're passionate about dispute resolution and ready to help shape the future of ADR in the region, we would love to hear from you!
q: Bachelor's degree in Law or equivalent. A relevant professional certification or postgraduate qualification is an advantage
At least 5 years of experience in business development, partnerships, marketing or client relations, ideally in the legal, ADR or professional services sector
Good understanding of BCDR's business environment and the ADR market
A track record of spotting opportunities and turning them into partnerships or new business
Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels
Strong research, analytical and report-writing skills
If you are ready to take the next step in your career within a forward-thinking organization, apply via LinkedIn.
r: Help develop the business development strategy, annual plan and budget, and lead assigned initiatives against agreed targets and KPIs
Find and assess new opportunities across markets, sectors, services and client segments, and present recommendations to the Business Development Director
Work with the internal stakeholders to grow existing services, launch new ones and find suitable arbitrators and mediators

Manage partnerships with government entities, ADR institutions, chambers of commerce, law firms, academic institutions and the media, building access to key decision-makers and looking for strategic alliances
Prepare negotiation strategies, draft proposals, MoUs and cooperation agreements, support negotiations, and follow up on what was agreed
Keep up-to-date intelligence on the regional ADR landscape, market trends and competitors, including through market research providers
Design campaigns, service offerings, promotional materials and social media content that increase uptake of BCDR's services, working with PR, agencies and other teams
Research and plan BCDR's participation in conferences, tradeshows and roadshows, and represent BCDR and present its services at these events
Manage the business development pipeline and CRM, track performance through clear metrics, and report on results to senior leadership and the Board
